# nemau_load_balancer_certificate (Resource)

A TLS certificate a `TERMINATED_HTTPS` `nemau_listener` serves, named by its `tls_certificate_ref`.

The private key is sent once and never returned by the API. It is stored in Terraform state, so keep that state encrypted. A certificate is immutable: any change replaces it. Names are unique in a project, so to renew without downtime set `name_prefix` rather than `name`, with `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }`. The new certificate gets a new generated name, the listener is repointed in place, and the old certificate is deleted last.

This resource cannot be imported, because an imported certificate would have no private key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_load_balancer_certificate" "www" {
  name_prefix = "www-"
  certificate = file("${path.module}/fullchain.pem")
  private_key = file("${path.module}/privkey.pem")

  # To renew, replace the two files and apply. The new certificate is created
  # first, the listener moves to it, and the old one is deleted.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate` (String) PEM certificate: the leaf, optionally followed by its chain (a fullchain.pem).
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM private key, without passphrase: RSA 2048 to 4096 bits, ECDSA P-256 or P-384. Write-only on the API: never read back.

### Optional

- `chain` (String) PEM intermediate certificates, when kept apart from `certificate`.
- `name` (String) Name, unique in the project. Conflicts with `name_prefix`; one of the two is required.
- `name_prefix` (String) Creates a unique name beginning with this prefix: the prefix, a UTC timestamp and 8 random hex digits. Conflicts with `name`. Use it with `create_before_destroy` to renew a certificate without choosing a new name.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (List of String) Names the certificate covers (its SANs).
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint, in the form `openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256` prints.
- `id` (String) Certificate ID, the value of a listener's `tls_certificate_ref`.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer of the certificate.
- `key_algorithm` (String) `RSA-2048` to `RSA-4096`, `ECDSA-P256` or `ECDSA-P384`.
- `not_after` (String) Expiry, RFC 3339.
- `not_before` (String) Start of validity, RFC 3339.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the certificate.
